spikes.question: Can recovery-runner support explicit parameterized exploratory scenario profiles with a small deterministic helper and CLI wiring while preserving fixed B1-B15 defaults and avoiding lifecycle gate changes?
spikes.note: run-driver.mjs already exports RECOVERY_SCENARIOS and accepts a scenarios list in enumerateCells; therefore the viable fix is a small validated parameterized-fault-profile helper, explicit --scenarioProfile/--scenarioParams CLI parsing, offline selfcheck coverage, and docs. No lifecycle/review/DONE/evidence hash code path needs to change.
